issues: The Fanfare Combo (3) effect is encoded incorrectly as playCostReduction amount 0; it should change this card's evolve cost to 0, using an evolve-cost-changing effect such as evolveCostReduction for 2 or equivalent self-targeted evolve-cost set/reduction logic.
evolvesFrom is incorrect; it should be "Treant", not "Treant Evolved".

The spell effect is incomplete: it only searches for up to 1 follower, but the source also lets you reveal up to 1 amulet and add it to your hand from among the top 7 cards, then put the rest on the bottom. It should encode selecting up to one follower and up to one amulet from the same looked-at cards. Implement an ability to choose multiple cards from a looked-at subset with separate card-type caps (for example, a multi-pick search/look effect supporting up to 1 follower and up to 1 amulet).

Necrocharge (10): Put 3 instead is encoded as an additional separate summon-3 ability, which would produce 4 Ghosts total. It should be a single Fanfare effect that summons 1 normally, or 3 instead if condition type necrocharge count 10 is met.
The keyword Intimidate is missing. It should be represented in keywords or passive keyword handling. Implement engine support for the Intimidate keyword if it is not currently supported.
